Article 5.title: Prohibited AI practices
Article 5.obligation: No social scoring, no manipulative/deceptive techniques, no emotion-recognition (workplace/education), no untargeted facial-scraping, no biometric categorisation for sensitive attributes

Article 6.title: High-risk classification
Article 6.obligation: Annex III high-risk systems — resume-screening, credit-scoring, biometric ID, education access, law-enforcement, migration, essential services

Article 9.title: Risk management system
Article 9.obligation: Establish + document a risk-management system for high-risk systems

Article 13.title: Transparency to deployers
Article 13.obligation: Inform deployers of capabilities + limitations (human oversight, accuracy, robustness)

Article 14.title: Human oversight
Article 14.obligation: High-risk systems designed for effective human oversight; incident/potential-incident reporting

Article 50.title: Transparency to end-users
Article 50.obligation: Disclose AI-generated content / interaction with AI; deepfake labelling

Article 53.title: GPAI model obligations
Article 53.obligation: General-purpose AI transparency — technical documentation, copyright policy, training-data summary

penalty_tiers.prohibited_practices: up to €35,000,000 or 7% of worldwide annual turnover (Art 99(3))
